chunk_text: Battery life has been noticeably worse since the November update. I get through maybe six hours of screen time now, down from eight when I bought it.
Camera quality in low light is a clear step up over the previous generation, with much less noise in night mode shots.
Eight months in and the battery still holds up through a full day of photography and gaming. No complaints on longevity so far.
Performance is fine for gaming but the phone gets warm during long sessions.
Battery on this Pixel is terrible, it barely lasts until lunchtime even with light use.
